```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
import ast
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import itables
from itables import show
import pandas as pd

pd.options.mode.chained_assignment = None
pd.options.future.infer_string = True

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

package_data_path = Path.cwd().parents[0] / "data" / "package_data.csv"
package_df = pd.read_csv(package_data_path)
package_df["gh_meta"] = package_df["gh_meta"].apply(
    lambda x: ast.literal_eval(x) if isinstance(x, str) else x
)


def _from_gh_meta(key):
    """Pull a value out of the per-row gh_meta dict, or return None."""
    return package_df["gh_meta"].apply(
        lambda x: x.get(key) if isinstance(x, dict) else None
    )


last_commit = pd.to_datetime(_from_gh_meta("last_commit"), utc=True, errors="coerce")
activity_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "package_name": package_df["package_name"],
    "package_description": package_df["package_description"],
    "repository_link": package_df["repository_link"],
    "last_commit": last_commit.dt.tz_localize(None),
    "created_at": pd.to_datetime(_from_gh_meta("created_at"), utc=True, errors="coerce").dt.tz_localize(None),
    "stargazers_count": _from_gh_meta("stargazers_count"),
    "watchers_count": _from_gh_meta("watchers_count"),
    "forks_count": _from_gh_meta("forks_count"),
    "open_issues_count": _from_gh_meta("open_issues_count"),
    "contrib_count": _from_gh_meta("contrib_count"),
})

cutoff = pd.Timestamp.now(tz="UTC").tz_localize(None) - pd.DateOffset(months=6)
active_mask = activity_df["last_commit"].notna() & (activity_df["last_commit"] >= cutoff)
total_active = int(active_mask.sum())
stale_df = (
    activity_df.loc[~active_mask]
    .sort_values("last_commit", ascending=True, na_position="first")
)
total_quiet = int(len(stale_df))


def show_packages(df, order=None):
    """Link each package name to its source repository."""
    name_column = df.columns.get_loc("package_name")
    link_column = df.columns.get_loc("repository_link")
    link_renderer = itables.JavascriptFunction(
        f"""
        function(data, type, row) {{
            if (type !== "display" || !row[{link_column}]) return data;

            const link = document.createElement("a");
            link.href = row[{link_column}];
            link.textContent = data;
            link.target = "_blank";
            link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
            return link.outerHTML;
        }}
        """
    )
    kwargs = {}
    if order is not None:
        kwargs["order"] = order
    return show(
        df,
        max_rows=15,
        showIndex=False,
        columnDefs=[
            {"targets": name_column, "render": link_renderer},
            {"targets": link_column, "visible": False},
        ],
        **kwargs,
    )
```

## Row {height=auto}

::: {.card title="Package activity"}
This dashboard tracks activity across pyOpenSci-accepted packages. Data is
pulled from the
[`data/packages.yml`](https://github.com/pyOpenSci/pyopensci.github.io/blob/main/data/packages.yml)
file in the `pyopensci.github.io` repository, which is maintained by
[`pyosMeta`](https://github.com/pyOpenSci/pyosMeta) and contains
per-package GitHub metrics including the date of the last commit.

A package is active when its latest commit is within the last six months.
Select a package name to open its repository.
:::

## Row {height=auto}

::: {.card title="All packages"}
Click the last commit column header to sort packages by most or least recent activity.

```{python}
show_packages(
    activity_df.sort_values("last_commit", ascending=False, na_position="last"),
)
```
:::

## Row {height=auto}

::: {.card title="No commits in the last 6 months"}
The table below shows packages whose most recent commit is older than six months, plus any package with no commit date on record. These are good candidates for maintenance check-ins or follow-up with maintainers.

```{python}
show_packages(stale_df)
```
:::
